title: Initialize report filename defaults for new and existing companies
summary: Report Filename Manager now initializes default filename patterns for 69 standard reports during company initialization, installation, and upgrade, ensuring consistent report naming without requiring manual setup.
key_points: New companies receive enabled filename setup with 65 report-specific defaults and 4 generic document defaults during Company-Initialize
Existing companies get missing configuration added during installation and upgrade without changing their feature switch or filename-length settings
Customized, filtered, or enabled patterns are preserved and not overwritten
Three reports with no document context (5085, 6520, 6521) use report name and date instead of document identifiers
Caller-owned server output paths are preserved for legacy API PDF generation while patterns apply to client display and attachment names
quote: Provision Report Filename Manager defaults through real company initialization, installation and upgrade.
